title: Envelope contract
condition: Envelope, payload and meta are frozen and versioned.

title: Delivery transport
condition: A message written by one agent lands in another agent's live turn.

title: Interrupt semantics
condition: Interrupt and normal delivery have one defined ordering.

title: Audit store
condition: Every envelope is append-only and replayable.

title: Team channel
condition: #team fan-out reaches every live session once.

title: PTY delivery
condition: Writes land without corrupting an in-flight turn.

title: WebSocket relay
condition: Browser clients receive the same envelopes.

title: Turn queue
condition: Normal messages queue to the turn boundary.

title: Teardown on retire
condition: Retiring an agent detaches its PTY.

title: Append-only log
condition: No envelope is ever rewritten.

title: Replay reader
condition: A thread can be rebuilt from the log alone.

title: Attention authority
condition: Exactly one subject can be elected at a time.

title: Release transition
condition: Resolving drains gold to sage and the next item inherits it.

title: Reduced-motion path
condition: The release is still legible with motion off.

title: Election rule
condition: Severity then age decides the elected subject.

title: Tier thresholds
condition: Three tiers with no gaps and no overlap.

title: Hysteresis band
condition: A pinch across a boundary cannot strobe.

title: Entry affordance
condition: Zoom alone never enters a Room.

title: Independent stores
condition: Scenes, Classes and Objects persist separately.

title: Accepted-commit marker
condition: prototype.json marks the accepted commit.

title: Object versioning
condition: Every object carries its own schemaVersion.

title: Migration path
condition: v1 documents open without loss.
